subject: general
question: The average marks scored by three students on a test were 55. When two more students (A and B) were added, the new average marks were reduced by 5. If B scores 15 marks more than A, what were the marks scored by A?
solution:
**Given:**

The average marks scored by three students were 55.

When two more students (A and B) were added, the average marks decreased by 5 (i.e., the new average is 50).

Student B scored 15 marks more than student A.

**Formulas Used:**

Average = Sum of observations / Number of observations

**Calculation:**

A = marks scored by student A

B = marks scored by student B

Sum of the marks scored by the first three students is 55 × 3 = 165 marks.

The total marks scored by the five students = 50 ×&n
